<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".28"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="28" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="25" x2="319" y2="25" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="23" x2="326" y2="23" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="21" x2="333" y2="21" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="23" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M338 20 Q344 14 350 20 M340 23 Q344 19 348 23" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="359" y="17" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="19" width="16" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#34EAB9"/>
    <line x1="382" y1="21" x2="384" y2="21" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header mark -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="42" cy="78" r="18" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <polygon points="34,82 42,70 50,82" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="38" y="80" width="8" height="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="70" y="84" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">news</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Greeting -->
  <text x="24" y="132" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Hello Again!</text>
  <text x="24" y="157" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Welcome back, we've missed you.</text>

  <!-- Username -->
  <text x="24" y="188" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Username or email</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="196" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="43" cy="220" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="232" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="62" y="225" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">alex.morgan@example.com</text>

  <!-- Password -->
  <text x="24" y="273" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Password</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="281" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="37" y="297" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M40 297 V294 Q43 289 46 294 V297" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="305" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="305" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="305" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
  <path d="M333 305 Q342 296 351 305 Q342 314 333 305 Z" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="305" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.3"/>

  <!-- Password support -->
  <rect x="24" y="348" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="28,358 33,363 41,353" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="363" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Remember me</text>
  <text x="250" y="363" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="390" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="421" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="24" y1="469" x2="164" y2="469" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="226" y1="469" x2="366" y2="469" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="474" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">or continue with</text>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="493" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M111 505 H115 V512 H120 L119 518 H115 V530 H108 V518 H104 V512 H108 V508 Q108 505 111 505 Z" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="143" y="523" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="203" y="493" width="163" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M286 505 A10 10 0 1 0 294 521 L290 518 H286 V514 H300 V510 H286 Z" fill="#4285F4"/>
    <path d="M286 505 A10 10 0 0 0 278 509" fill="none" stroke="#EA4335" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M278 509 A10 10 0 0 0 278 517" fill="none" stroke="#FBBC05" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M278 517 A10 10 0 0 0 286 521" fill="none" stroke="#34A853" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="323" y="523" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Security note -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="580" r="12" fill="#263D59"/>
    <path d="M36 579 V576 Q39 571 42 576 V579" fill="none" stroke="#7DB5FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="35" y="579" width="8" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#7DB5FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="60" y="578" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Your privacy matters</text>
    <text x="60" y="598" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Your account information is protected and secure.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Sign up prompt -->
  <text x="195" y="648" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Don't have an account?</text>
  <text x="195" y="674" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Create an account</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#25272A"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="43,792 53,783 63,792" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="47" y="791" width="12" height="11" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="53" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="131" cy="792" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="138" y1="799" x2="145" y2="806" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="131" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="208" y="784" width="18" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="208,801 213,797 218,801 223,797 226,801" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="217" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="310" cy="789" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="310" cy="801" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="310" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
